title: GMI theme-graph node lifecycle row v1
description: One ROW of data/theme_graph/node_lifecycle.parquet, as a JSON object. Rule gmi.node_lifecycle/v1 (V4-D2B3, research/prophet_v4/d2/D2B3_FROZEN_CONTRACT_2026-08-21.md §2 R-D2B3-1). A SIDE-CAR lineage, never a nodes.parquet rewrite: node rows are keep-first write-once (NODE_KEY=(node_id,)), so a retirement/merge can never be expressed as an in-place status flip without rewriting history. Keyed (node_id, computed_at) with a latest-by-computed_at read collapse — the exact pattern capability.parquet and identity_resolution.parquet already use. store.read_nodes(current=True) overlays the latest row per node_id onto status/retire_date/merged_into; the raw table (current=False, the default) is unaffected.

node_id.description: The node this lineage row applies to. Must resolve to a row in nodes.parquet (guard-enforced) — a lifecycle row for a node that was never minted is a resolution of nothing.

status.description: Target state, from the SAME enum nodes.status carries. D2B3 mints only retired rows; merged is reserved for a future merge lineage using this same table.

retire_date.description: For reason=identity_break: the ratified break row's own break_date, VERBATIM (dates law, §9 — never invented, never backdated). For reason=entity_type_conflict: the correction's own execution date (there is no world-event break date; the company-plane interpretation was never true, so this records when the graph's active interpretation ENDED, not a fact about the world).

merged_into.description: Target node_id when status=merged. Null for every retired row D2B3 mints.

reason.description: identity_break: a ratified row in config/theme_graph_identity_breaks.yml retires the PRIOR holder of a reused symbol. entity_type_conflict: a company-kind node collides with an etf-kind node for the same symbol in the committed store — the company-plane interpretation was structurally wrong, not historically superseded.

evidence.description: VERBATIM pointer, never free prose asserting a fact the pointer does not carry: for identity_break, the breaks-registry row's own (market, symbol) plus its ratified_at; for entity_type_conflict, the conflicting etf node id plus whatever machine-visible identity_resolution sidecar receipts already recorded the collision (same receipts the D2A sidecar's ENTITY_TYPE_CONFLICT rows already emit).

ratified_by.description: For identity_break: carried VERBATIM from the breaks-registry row's own ratified_by. For entity_type_conflict: the ratifying act — the V4-D2B3 frozen contract itself (Sol's commission), since no breaks-registry row exists for a structural entity-kind correction.

computed_at.description: The ACTUAL correction execution time — never backdated (§9 dates law). For reason=identity_break this must not predate the cited breaks-registry row's own ratified_at (guard-enforced, matrix 7 / R-A4 / R-A9).
